smart-poi 2.0.0 introduces major new features and an expanded scope:

- 新增酒店、美食、火车票、机票等多类查询工具，技能覆盖更广
- 工具接口全面升级，支持图片、评分、价格、预订/购票链接输出
- 原有景点推荐、天气、交通等接口合并重整，参数更清晰结构化
- 技能描述、标签和示例全面更新，突出“即装即用”和多数据源能力
- 移除旧文档（skill-card.md），增加_meta.json辅助元数据
修复SH镜像摘要乱码：description改为自然中文句子格式

- Initial release of smart-poi: zero-configuration, ready-to-use travel POI assistant.
- Includes 6 main tools: AI attraction recommendation, structured ticket search, fast ticket search, nearby attractions, weather queries, and transportation options.
- Integrates data directly from Fliggy and Amap.
- Supports natural language queries and location-based searches.
- No user data storage; all queries are securely relayed via cloud proxy.
